North Reading (pronounced, as is with Reading as ( (listen)) is a town in Middlesex County, Massachusetts, United States. The population was 15,554 at the 2020 census.


== History ==
The area was first settled in 1651 when the town of Reading received a special land grant north of the Ipswich River.
